items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: Baion and samba and the way they dance, I mean, and seven-four sambas and my God, those are very sophisticated.

ctx.x: Very interesting. A signature sound. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

It’s a very earth-connected music to me, because of all those influences. They have jungle sounds and the cuica and all these instruments that evoke the jungle and then you have those beautiful harmonies from Europe, and then you have this more primitive — primitive is hardly the word because it’s very sophisticated. The rhythms are very sophisticated. Baion and samba and the way they dance, I mean, and seven-four sambas and my God, those are very sophisticated. So all these elements, you know there is this…
Yeah it’s interesting what we call primitive.
